gloss: to get sunburned; to get a tan; to fade from sunlight

forms.label: Past polite
forms.negative: {日焼|ひや}けしませんでした

forms.label: ている past
forms.negative: {日焼|ひや}けしていなかった

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {日焼|ひや}けしていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to get sunburned; to get a tan; to become darkened by the sun
definitions.explanation: For skin to darken or burn from exposure to sunlight. Covers both deliberate tanning and accidental sunburn.

definitions.gloss: to fade from sunlight; to become discolored by sun exposure
definitions.explanation: For paper, fabric, photographs, or other materials to fade, yellow, or become damaged from prolonged exposure to sunlight.

examples.japanese: ⟦{夏|なつ}→夏：02236_natsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{日焼|ひや}けした。
examples.english: I got tanned in the summer.

examples.japanese: ⟦{海|うみ}→海：00556_umi⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{日焼|ひや}けして⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: I got sunburned at the beach and my skin turned red.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{塗|ぬ}らない→塗る：01174_nuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{日焼|ひや}けしやすい。

examples.english: The curtains faded from sun exposure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{窓際|まどぎわ}→窓際：08400_madogiwa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{置|お}いていた→置く：01092_oku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{写真|しゃしん}→写真：00753_shashin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦すっかり→すっかり：01270_sukkari⟧{日焼|ひや}けしてしまった。
examples.english: Because I had left it by the window, the photograph became completely sun-faded.

notes:
A ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧-verb from the noun ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧, composed of ⟦{日|ひ}→日：02249_hi⟧ (sun) + ⟦{焼|や}け→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ (burning, from ⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧). The noun ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧ is used independently for sunburn/tan or sun damage.

USAGE:
For skin (sense 1), Japanese does not strongly distinguish between "tan" (gradual browning) and "sunburn" (painful reddening) — both are ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧. Context clarifies. The compound ⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧ (sunscreen) is one of the most common related words.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}め→日焼け止め：05120_hiyakedome⟧ — sunscreen
- ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧⟦サロン→サロン：10952_saron⟧ — tanning salon
- ⟦{日焼|ひや}け→日焼け：15469_hiyake⟧⟦{跡|あと}→跡：02174_ato⟧ — tan lines; sun marks
- {日焼|ひや}けした⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ — tanned/sunburned skin

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{焼|や}ける→焼ける：01138_yakeru⟧ — to burn (broader; cooking, fire, jealousy)
- {色|いろ}{褪|あ}せる — to fade, to lose color (general fading, not only from sun)
- ⟦{変色|へんしょく}する→変色する：19529_henshokusuru⟧ — to discolor, to change color (technical; any color change)
